title: UNAV Internal Beta Talk
description: Three-step lecture walking through the demo mission.
presenter_notes: Welcome the audience. Introduce the demo dataset. Mention this is an internal beta build.

steps.title: Pleiades Star
steps.narration: We begin at one of the demo Pleiades stars, ~137 parsec from Earth.
steps.presenter_notes: Mention parallax = 1000 / d_pc; emphasise the v3.2 provenance shows the source.

steps.title: Earth
steps.narration: Now we hop to Earth's barycentric position at the bundled epoch.
steps.presenter_notes: Note the JPL row carries an explicit epoch_jd; the v1.2 time navigator picks the snapshot.

steps.title: Mars
steps.narration: And finally Mars, still at the same epoch — note the parallax shift.
steps.presenter_notes: Hand control back to the audience for Q&A.
